pull.title: feat(ai): transcribe speech with a ChatGPT/Codex subscription
pull.body:
## What

Add support for transcription over Codex subscriptions.

Adds the `openai-codex/codex-transcribe` speech-to-text model on a new `openai-codex-transcriptions` runner API. It posts multipart `file`/`language` to ChatGPT's dictation endpoint (`POST https://chatgpt.com/backend-api/transcribe`) with the Codex OAuth bearer, `ChatGPT-Account-Id` and the Codex Desktop identity that live mode already sends (Cloudflare answers 403 without it). Non-chatgpt.com base URL overrides are ignored, so the bearer only goes to chatgpt.com.

- TUI dictation, `omp auth-gateway serve` and `omp auth-gateway stdio` (`/v1/audio/transcriptions`) accept it: the gates now check `runnerApiKind(api) === "stt"` instead of `openai-transcriptions`.
- `omp auth-gateway stdio` resolved only chat selectors, so every stt/tts/image model answered 404. It now tries chat models first and falls back to the full catalog, so a chat selector still wins over a same-named runner.
- The upload is renamed to match its container: the endpoint answers `500 {"detail":"Error in ASR API"}` for `voice.oga` or an extensionless name, even with valid Ogg/Opus bytes. The ext/MIME table moved to `transcription/types.ts` and is shared with the gateway parser (which now knows `oga`).
- Transcription error details are capped at 500 characters, so a Cloudflare HTML page no longer becomes the whole error message.

## Why

ChatGPT/Codex subscribers can dictate without an OpenAI API key or a local STT model, using the login omp already holds. omp-web uses this through `omp auth-gateway stdio`.

The endpoint is private and undocumented (the one Codex Desktop dictation uses), so it can change without notice.

## Testing

- Live, against a real Codex subscription, with the Whisper JFK clip piped to `bun packages/coding-agent/src/cli.ts auth-gateway stdio` as `{"model":"openai-codex/codex-transcribe","input_audio":{...}}`: FLAC returns 200 with the text ("And so, my fellow Americans, ask not what your country can do for you…"), and Ogg/Opus declared as `format: "oga"` returns 200 too (it returned 500 before the rename).
- Direct endpoint probes: Ogg/Opus `audio.ogg`, WebM/Opus `audio.webm` and AAC `audio.mp4` answer 200; the same Ogg bytes as `voice.oga`, `audio` or `audio.webm` answer 500; no Codex Desktop identity gives a 403.
- `bun check:ts` passes. `packages/ai` transcription and gateway tests, the full `packages/catalog` suite, and `packages/coding-agent` `stt-cloud`, `auth-gateway-stdio`, `role-info` and `live/` tests pass.
- I did not test TUI dictation with a real microphone; `stt-cloud.test.ts` covers the gate.

---

- [x] `bun check` passes
- [x] Tested locally
- [x] CHANGELOG updated with the required attribution (if user-facing; internal issue fixes use issue links, external contributions add the PR link and contributor credit after creation)

commit.message:
fix(ai): address Codex transcription review

- Name browser `audio/mp3` and `audio/x-mp3` uploads `audio.mp3`, and infer the container from a known suffix when the MIME type is generic (`voice.oga` -> `audio.ogg`).
- Refuse an `openai-codex` base URL off the ChatGPT HTTPS origin: it points at a relay whose key outranks the OAuth login and must not reach chatgpt.com.
- Share one route/API predicate (`gatewayRouteAccepts`) between the image route, the served `/v1/models` catalog and stdio fallback chains, so unroutable models (Codex `gpt-image-2`, on-device runners) are neither advertised nor tried as fallbacks.
- Spy on the attestation header in the test instead of clearing the process-wide provider.
- Move the #15391 changelog entries under [Unreleased].

commit.message:
fix(coding-agent): keep known-provider prefixes locked in auth-gateway stdio selectors

The per-kind registry views dropped ModelRegistry.hasProvider, so a selector for a configured provider with an empty catalog (proxy/foo) could fuzzy-match another provider's proxy/foo-latest. Forward it through both views.
